narrator
text: Delhi NCR. Population: yes. Air quality: also yes.

speaker: new_kid
text: Okay. New city, new job, new flat. An *11-month rent agreement*. How hard can it be?

speaker: narrator
text: The agreement says *temporary* on every page. In NCR, that word means something different.

speaker: new_kid
text: I just need one *stamp* from the Sarkari Daftar to make it official. One stamp.

speaker: narrator
text: You will need more than one stamp.

speaker: pinky_aunty
text: Beta! You are the new tenant in B-204? I am Pinky. RWA WhatsApp group admin. Since 2011.

speaker: new_kid
text: Uh, hi aunty. I was just going to—

speaker: pinky_aunty
text: Eating properly? You look thin. Married? Salary? Don't answer, I will find out.

speaker: pinky_aunty
text: Listen. This city will eat you alive. I will help you. But first...

speaker: pinky_aunty
text: Forward this to 10 people. Otherwise very bad luck. Sharma ji didn't forward, and now his flat has *seepage*.

speaker: broker
text: Sir! Sir! Welcome welcome. Very nice flat, sir. East-facing. Vastu-compliant. Metro walking distance.

speaker: new_kid
text: The metro is 4 km away.

speaker: broker
text: Walking distance for a fit person, sir. Now. Small matter of *brokerage*.

speaker: broker
text: One month brokerage. One month deposit. One month "documentation". One month "my cousin's wedding".

speaker: new_kid
text: That's four months!

speaker: broker
text: Sir, the owner is *very nice*. Very nice. Let's settle this the Delhi way.

speaker: broker
text: Okay okay! Sir, half brokerage. Final. Okay, quarter. Okay, I'll throw in a free... *temporary address proof*.

speaker: new_kid
text: Is it valid?

speaker: broker
text: Valid for 11 months, sir. Like everything.

speaker: ceo
text: Hey! Quick question. Have you ever thought about walking... but as a *service*?

speaker: new_kid
text: No.

speaker: ceo
text: That's the problem we're solving. We're *Walkr*. Pre-revenue. Post-logic. Our Series A closes tonight.

speaker: ceo
text: And you're blocking my pitch. Time to *pivot*... to violence. Strategic, scalable violence.

speaker: ceo
text: Okay so. Personal news. After an incredible journey, we're *shutting down*.

speaker: ceo
text: I've learnt so much. Mostly that runway is temporary. I'll post about it.

speaker: new_kid
text: Please don't.

speaker: ceo
text: Already posted. 40k likes. I'm thinking of starting a podcast.

speaker: babu
text: Hmm.

speaker: new_kid
text: Hello sir, I need one stamp on this form. Just one stamp.

speaker: babu
text: Form? Which form? This is the *old form*. New form came yesterday. Also, it is 1 o'clock.

speaker: babu
text: I said what I said. Original, three photocopies, self-attested, attested by gazetted officer... and your *soul*.

speaker: babu
text: Come. Let us begin the procedure.

speaker: babu
text: ...Fine. Stamped. Now go.

speaker: new_kid
text: *VALID FOR 11 MONTHS*. Wait. My lease started 11 months ago.

speaker: babu
text: Then your lease is over. Renewal needs a new form. *Come tomorrow.*

speaker: narrator
text: Your phone buzzes. *Delivery Wale Bhaiya*: "Sir, 2 minute."

speaker: new_kid
text: ...I love this city.

speaker: narrator
text: Everything is temporary. Except Delhi.
